Job Description
  
  

Role Purpose
  
  

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters
  
  

͏

1\. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software

Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
  
Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
  
Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
  
Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
  
Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
  
Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities
  
͏
  
  

2\. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development
  
  

Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
  
Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
  
Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
  
Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
  
Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
  
Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
  
Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
  
Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
  
Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
  
Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders
  
͏
  
  

3\. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution
  
  

Capturing all the requirements and clarifications from the client for better quality work
  
Taking feedback on the regular basis to ensure smooth and on time delivery
  
Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members.
  
Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software\-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
  
Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
  
Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
  
Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e\-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
  
Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally
  
͏
  
  

Deliver
  
  

No. Performance Parameter Measure
  
1\. Continuous Integration, Deployment \& Monitoring of Software 100% error free on boarding \& implementation, throughput %, Adherence to the schedule/ release plan
  
2\. Quality \& CSAT On\-Time Delivery, Manage software, Troubleshoot queries, Customer experience, completion of assigned certifications for skill upgradation
  
3\. MIS \& Reporting 100% on time MIS \& report generation
  
  

**Mandatory Skills:** Python for Insights .
  
  

**Experience:** 5\-8 Years .

jobs.description:
**Role Summary \& Role Description**


We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Application Developer to support and implement ServiceNow solutions for \[Sourcing \& Procurement Operations \| Hardware and Software Asset Lifecycle ] as well as design, build, and customize platform applications. In this role, you will be a member of a geographically distributed team of ServiceNow developers and administrators. This position requires technical development expertise and strong knowledge of the baseline ServiceNow module capabilities to ensure the smooth operation and continual enhancement of the ServiceNow platform.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**ServiceNow Platform Development:**

* Deliver business application needs while preserving baseline functionality with customization and extension of the platform modules.
* Designs and develops new ServiceNow applications and services.
* Refactor Assist ServiceNow business Drive the adoption and utilization of ServiceNow services across the organization, identifying opportunities for innovation and efficiency.

**Service Delivery and Issue Resolution:**

* Assists ServiceNow System Administrators with incident resolution, as needed.
* Provides mentoring and guidance for ServiceNow System Administrators.
* Takes ownership of complex business requirements and works them to completion.

**Continuous Improvement and Innovation:**

* Identify and implement opportunities for automation and process optimization within ServiceNow workflows.
* Stay current on ServiceNow product developments, industry trends, and best practices to recommend improvements.

**Core/Must have skills**


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.


5\+ years of experience in professional software development.


5\+ years of experience in ServiceNow platform development.


Deep knowledge of ServiceNow modules, including ITSM, ITAM, ITBM, and Service Catalog.


Proficiency in scripting (e.g., JavaScript, Glide API) and building custom workflows and integrations.


Experience with incident, problem, and change management processes within an ITIL framework.


Strong requirements gathering and refining experience.

**Good to have skills**


ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD). ServiceNow Implementation Specialist Certifications (e.g., ITSM, HAM, VR).


ITIL v3 or ITIL v4 Foundation Certification.


Strong problem\-solving and analytical abilities, especially under pressure.


Ability to communicate effectively and in a professional manner both written and orally. Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results in a fast\-paced environment.


Be a team player with a positive attitude, enthusiasm, initiative, and self\-motivation.


Ability to multi\-task, meet aggressive timelines and have strong work ethics.

**Work Schedule**


Hybrid

**Keywords (If any)**


 ITSM, ITAM, ITBM, and Service Catalog, ServiceNow Developer

**Location**


Hyderabad,

**Why this role is important to us**


Our technology function, Global Technology Services (GTS), is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We’re driving the company’s digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence and robotics process automation.


We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We’re looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end\-to\-end, next\-generation financial services company.


Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems and make your mark on our industry.

**About State Street**

**What we do.** State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data \& analytics, investment research \& trading and investment management to institutional clients.

**Work, Live and Grow.** We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary by location, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans, among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Programs to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.

**Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.** We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift programs and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.


State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.


Discover more at StateStreet.com/careers

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, FinOps
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Senior Product Manager – Finance Operations (Employee Expense \& Corporate Cards)  

  

Overview  

  

We are seeking a highly motivated and strategic Senior Product Manager to lead the Employee Expense and Corporate Cards product portfolio within Finance Operations. This role presents a unique opportunity to define and build the next generation of AI/ML\-powered, enterprise\-scale financial products that simplify expense management, enhance user experience, strengthen controllership, and deliver meaningful operational cost savings.  

  

As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the product strategy, roadmap, execution, adoption, and success metrics for solutions supporting employee expenses and corporate card programs. You will partner with leading global card providers, internal business teams, and technology organizations to build innovative products that operate at Amazon scale.  

  

The ideal candidate combines strong product management fundamentals with deep customer obsession, analytical rigor, and the ability to influence across a complex stakeholder ecosystem. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, thinking strategically while maintaining operational excellence, and leveraging emerging AI technologies to solve challenging business problems.  

  

This role requires close collaboration with engineering, data science, analytics, design, finance, operations, and external partners to create scalable solutions that improve customer experiences while maintaining strong financial controls and compliance standards.  

  

Key Responsibilities  

  

Product Vision, Strategy \& Roadmap  

  

Define and drive the long\-term vision, strategy, and roadmap for Employee Expense and Corporate Cards products.  

Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, improve customer experience, enhance financial controls, and reduce operational costs through automation and AI\-driven solutions.  

Evaluate industry trends, customer feedback, business needs, and operational challenges to uncover high\-impact product opportunities.  

Develop product tenets, strategic goals, business cases, and investment proposals to support long\-term product direction.  

Create and maintain multi\-year product roadmaps aligned with organizational objectives and business priorities.  

  

Product Discovery \& Innovation  

  

Partner with customers, operations teams, finance stakeholders, and leadership teams to identify pain points and unmet needs.  

Leverage customer insights, operational data, and market intelligence to prioritize product investments.  

Drive innovation through AI/ML\-powered capabilities that improve efficiency, decision\-making, compliance monitoring, and user experience.  

Translate complex business problems into scalable product solutions with measurable outcomes.  

  

Product Planning \& Requirements Management  

  

Author compelling PRFAQs, business requirement documents (BRDs), product requirement documents (PRDs), strategy documents, and executive review materials.  

Define clear product requirements, user journeys, workflows, and success criteria.  

Lead cross\-functional planning sessions and facilitate alignment across business and technical stakeholders.  

Ensure product decisions are grounded in customer needs, business objectives, and technical feasibility.  

  

Cross\-Functional Leadership  

  

Collaborate closely with Software Development Engineers (SDEs), Data Scientists (DSs), Data Engineers (DEs), Business Intelligence Engineers (BIEs), Business Analysts (BAs), UX Designers (UXDs), Program Managers, Finance teams, and Operations leaders.  

Lead discussions and decision\-making forums with senior executives and stakeholders.  

Manage relationships with both first\-party (internal) and third\-party (external) partners, including global card issuers, payment providers, and technology vendors.  

Drive alignment among stakeholders with competing priorities while maintaining focus on customer and business outcomes.  

  

Product Development \& Execution  

  

Partner with engineering teams throughout product design, development, testing, and deployment.  

Evaluate trade\-offs between customer value, business impact, technical complexity, effort, and delivery timelines.  

Support technical teams during scoping, architecture discussions, design reviews, and implementation planning.  

Ensure products are delivered with high quality, scalability, reliability, and operational excellence.  

  

Metrics, Analytics \& Business Performance  

  

Define key input and output metrics to measure product success and business impact.  

Establish KPI frameworks, audit mechanisms, reporting standards, evaluation methodologies, and self\-inspection processes.  

Partner with BIEs, BAs, and DEs to build scalable reporting solutions and performance dashboards.  

Continuously monitor product performance and identify opportunities for optimization and improvement.  

Present business performance insights and recommendations to leadership teams.  

  

Product Launch \& Operational Readiness  

  

Own end\-to\-end launch planning and execution for new product features and capabilities.  

Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Pilot Validation Testing (PVT), launch readiness reviews, and rollout planning activities.  

Coordinate cross\-functional launch activities across product, engineering, operations, finance, and external partners.  

Ensure smooth deployment, operational readiness, risk mitigation, and post\-launch monitoring.  

  

Adoption, Change Management \& Customer Engagement  

  

Develop and execute product socialization, communication, and adoption strategies.  

Drive customer onboarding, training programs, demonstrations, workshops, and enablement activities.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Tech, Amazon Appstore
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join the Amazon Appstore team where we delight customers across devices with a vast selection of relevant apps, games, and services by making it effortless for developers to deliver delightful app experiences. We are seeking a Senior Product Manager \- Technical to lead our multi\-year vision for the Developer Reporting and Analytics charter. If you're passionate about turning data into developer growth, building API\-first and AI\-native products at global scale, and helping developers make confident, evidence\-based decisions about their apps, we want to hear from you.  

Our charter is to make data\-driven decisions effortless for App developers by transforming the Appstore Developer Console into their most trusted hub for business and app\-performance data. We help developers measure their app KPIs and health, identify growth opportunities through reliable real\-time data and end\-to\-end funnel visibility, intervene with quantified end\-user impact based on trends of key drivers, and take measures through actionable insights specific to their app.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Shape Product Strategy: Define and deliver our multi\-year vision and product strategy for an API\-first, AI\-native developer reporting solution. Own critical performance metrics, drive prioritization and make high\-judgment trade\-offs for Reporting products.
  

Champion Developer Success: Act as a passionate advocate for 3P developers, leverage voice of developers, telemetry instrumentation and cross\-functional inputs from research, marketing, and solution architects to identify and eliminate friction in the developer's measure, diagnose and optimize loop.
  

Drive Cross\-Functional Impact: Collaborate with Appstore teams, internal developers, and key 3P developer stakeholders to deliver complex, cross\-team workstreams.  

Lead with Global Perspective: Work with our high\-energy, geographically distributed teams across India and US. Build product experiences and technical solutions that deliver meaningful business impact in rapidly growing emerging markets while meeting the bar of mature global developer ecosystems. Independently represent the charter in leadership forums; author strategic narratives on multi year roadmap, trade\-offs, and investment.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Manager - Product Development & Innovation
jobs.description:
**About the Company:** 




  





 Sunoha is an emerging food and beverage company building innovative coffee, tea, nutrition, and convenience\-beverage products for domestic and international markets.
 



 It supplies roasted coffee, instant coffee, liquid coffee decoctions, and customised beverage solutions to cafés, restaurants, hotels, offices, and foodservice businesses across India.
 



 The company is now expanding into coffee premixes, tea premixes, malt\-based nutritional beverages, cocoa beverages, and other value\-added products for export markets \- with a particular focus on Africa and the Middle East. To power this next phase of growth, Sunoha is establishing a dedicated Product Development \& Innovation Center (PDIC) to create market\-leading products and unlock new business opportunities.
 



  





**Function** 




 Product Development \& Innovation Center (PDIC)
 



**Location** 




 Hyderabad, Telangana, India
 



**Work Model** 




 On\-site (full\-time)
 



**Reporting to:** 




 Founders
 



**Compensation:** 




 ₹12–15 LPA fixed
 



**Employment type:** 




 Full\-time, permanent
 







**Qualifications needed:** 




**Education** 




 B.Tech / M.Tech in Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy Technology, Nutrition, or a related discipline.
 



**Experience** 




 4–7 years of product\-development / R\&D experience in beverages, nutritional products, coffee, tea, malt beverages, premixes, or FMCG foods, including hands\-on formulation and experience taking products to launch.
 



  





**Job Description:** 





 Sunoha is building its Product Development \& Innovation function and this is a senior, hands\-on role at the heart of it.
 




 You will drive the development of new beverage and nutrition products from concept to commercial launch, lead key projects end to end, and help shape how the company innovates as it scales across India and into export markets.
 



 The Manager leads and executes the development of new beverage and nutrition products from concept to commercialisation, focusing on coffee premixes, tea premixes, malt\-based nutritional beverages, functional beverages, and related products for domestic and export markets.
 



 You will own projects end to end \- benchmarking target products, sourcing ingredients, developing and optimising formulations, running trials, and steering successful launches; while helping establish the PDIC's processes and innovation pipeline.
 



 You will have real ownership, direct access to the founders, and room to grow into broader leadership of the function as it expands.
 



  





**Key responsibilities:** 




  





**Product Development \& Formulation** 



* **Formulate \&** 
**Benchmark** 
**:** 

 Develop and optimise formulations for premixes, malt, functional, and nutritional beverages and compare them to
 

 target
 

 benchmark
 

 products to ensure winning specifications
 

 .
* **Trial:** 

 Plan and run laboratory and pilot\-scale trials with rigorous documentation.
* **Optimise:** 

 Balance taste, functionality, nutrition, stability, shelf\-life, and cost.



  





**Ingredient \& Supplier Development** 



* **Source \& qualify:** 

 Identify ingredients, evaluate functionality, and qualify reliable, cost\-effective suppliers.
* **De\-risk:** 

 Develop alternate suppliers to strengthen supply security and pricing.



  





**Market Intelligence** 



* **Scan \& evaluate:** 

 Track trends and consumer preferences across India and export markets; evaluate new opportunities and build the case.
* **Benchmark:** 

 Run competitor analysis and product benchmarking.



  





**Sensory \& Consumer Evaluation** 



* **Test \& refine:** 

 Organise tasting panels and customer evaluations, and refine products on feedback.
* **Standardise:** 

 Establish sensory standards and reference profiles for batch consistency.



  





**Regulatory \& Documentation** 



* **Document:** 

 Prepare nutritional information, specifications, and technical documents.
* **Comply:** 

 Ensure compliance with FSSAI and target export\-market requirements; maintain development records and product IP.



  





**Commercialisation \& Scale\-Up** 



* **Scale:** 

 Support pilot and factory trials, coordinate with manufacturing, and troubleshoot during scale\-up.
* **Collaborate:** 

 Partner with sales, supply chain, and leadership to land launches commercially.



  





**Project Leadership** 



* **Lead projects:** 

 Run product\-development projects end to end against timelines and a clear stage\-gate.
* **Mentor:** 

 As the team grows, guide and mentor junior product\-development staff.
* **Pipeline:** 

 Contribute to a prioritised innovation pipeline aligned to business strategy.



  





**Skills Required** 




**Technical Skills** 



* Food science and beverage technology
* Product formulation and recipe development
* Ingredient functionality and food chemistry
* Nutritional and functional product development
* Sensory evaluation and shelf\-life studies
* Process scale\-up and manufacturing transfer
* Regulatory compliance (FSSAI and export\-market standards)
* Cost optimisation and margin engineering



  





**General Skills** 



* Analytical thinking and structured problem\-solving
* Project management and disciplined execution

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**
 GE Vernova is seeking a strategic, customer\-obsessed Senior Product Manager to lead GridBeats™ Device Management (DvM) — a core component of GridBeats™, our portfolio of software\-defined automation solutions for grid digitalization.
   

  

 GridBeats™ DvM is a powerful software suite enabling remote monitoring, control, and lifecycle management of grid intelligent electronic devices (IEDs) — including protection relays, fault recorders, power quality meters, and sensing equipment. Designed for distribution and transmission utilities, renewable operators, and industrial customers, DvM enhances operational efficiency, cybersecurity, and system resilience.
   

  

 As Senior Product Manager, you will own product strategy, discovery, and delivery — working directly with customers and cross\-functional teams to build solutions that solve real problems, deliver measurable outcomes, and shape the future of grid automation.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Vision \& Strategy**
* Define and own a compelling, outcome\-driven product vision, strategy, and multi\-year roadmap aligned with GridBeats™ business goals.
* Translate market insights and customer problems into prioritized opportunities with measurable business outcomes — not just a list of features.
* Make crisp, well\-reasoned prioritization decisions and align senior stakeholders across product, engineering, sales, and executive leadership.


**Customer \& Market Discovery**
* Conduct continuous customer discovery — engaging operators, protection engineers, and utility leaders to uncover deep pain points and unmet needs.
* Monitor competitive dynamics, regulatory trends (NERC CIP, IEC 61850, IEC 62351\), and technology shifts to inform strategy.
* Represent GE Vernova at industry events and conferences (DistribuTECH, CIGRE, etc.).


**Product Definition \& Delivery**
* Lead the full product lifecycle — from concept and business case through requirements, development, launch, and post\-launch iteration.
* Write crisp, outcome\-focused product artifacts — opportunity canvases, PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that communicate intent without over\-specifying solutions.
* Work in close collaboration with commercial, engineering, design \& delivery teams.


**Go\-to\-Market \& Sales Enablement**
* Partner with Marketing to develop impactful messaging, collateral, and campaigns across all channels.
* Work with global sales teams to build key customer relationships, execute go\-to\-market strategies, and deliver product training and awareness programs.


**Performance \& Metrics**
* Define and track product KPIs — including adoption, retention, time\-to\-value, financial results, and market share.
* Use quantitative and qualitative evidence to drive decisions and implement continuous improvement or course corrections.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* 10\+ years in product management, including 3\+ years leading industrial or enterprise B2B software products.
* Experience building modern software products using containers and microservices architectures, supporting multiple deployment models (on\-premise, cloud, SaaS).
* Proficiency in data\-driven decision\-making — defining metrics, running analyses, and navigating ambiguity to develop and communicate product strategy.
* Hands\-on experience with modern product innovation methodologies — Product Discovery, Lean Startup, Design Thinking, or similar.
* Familiarity with Agile and other NPI methodologies.
* Ability to work effectively with globally distributed, cross\-functional teams; willingness to travel as required.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Direct experience with electrical utilities, smart grid, device management, protection relays, SCADA, fault recorders, IoT, or industrial protocols (Modbus, DNP3, IEC 61850\).
* Familiarity with AI/ML tools to enhance product management productivity and inform product capabilities
* MBA or advanced degree — highly desired


**Desired Characteristics**
* A self\-starter and strategic thinker with a bias for action.
* Customer\-obsessed and passionate about identifying and solving real\-world problems.
* Outcome\-driven, with a focus on measurable impact.
* An excellent communicator who can simplify complexity.
* Comfortable influencing stakeholders at all levels.
* Strong data literacy — comfortable defining metrics, running analyses, and using quantitative and qualitative evidence to drive decisions
* Motivated by the energy transition and its global impact.


 Join us to shape the future of grid automation and accelerate the energy transition.
   

  

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes

**About Aqua Security** 




 Aqua Security enables enterprises to secure their container‑based and cloud‑native applications from development to production—accelerating adoption of cloud‑native technologies and bridging the gap between DevOps and IT Security.
 



 Our product ecosystem includes multiple components deployed in customers’ cloud environments, complemented by SaaS services, CI/CD plugins, and cloud‑native integrations. Most components run in containers, are written in Go, and rely heavily on open‑source technologies. Our UI is built with Vue.js. We are primarily a Linux‑focused company, with additional support for Windows and macOS.
 



 We operate in a fast‑paced R\&D culture that values experimentation, modern technologies, and a blend of experienced and early‑career engineers who are passionate about building world‑class security products.

 **18\+ years experience and**

 .
* Demonstrated experience building

 .
* Strong cloud‑security knowledge—expertise in

 , including networking, IAM, Kubernetes, and/or serverless.

* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills; ability to use data to guide decisions.
* Highly self‑driven with a track record of executing in fast‑moving environments.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you interested in building high\-performance, globally scalable Financial systems that support Amazon's current and future growth? Are you seeking an environment where you can drive innovation? Does the prospect of working with top engineering talent get you charged up? If so, Amazon Finance Technology (FinTech) is for you!  

  

Amazon's Finance Technology organization (FinTech) builds and maintains the finance technology platforms and services that enable new business growth, compliance with financial and tax reporting obligations, and analysis of our financial data. Through our products, we aim to maximize time spent by Finance teams on high value analysis, reduce the growth of operating expenses, and improve the vendor experience.  

This role will focus on Fixed Assets, which is a significant line on Amazon’s balance sheet and growing 26% YOY. They range widely from buildings, furniture, servers, delivery vehicles, drones, airplanes, robots, etc. and are in every country in which we do business. We are building systems that service the fixed asset needs of tax, accounting, and finance teams worldwide, and automating transactions from asset creation through disposal. It is multi\-year challenge and we are building a team with the technical chops to revolutionize fixed assets well beyond what any tier 1 ERPs can do today.  

  

We are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead a team of software engineers in our Hyderabad, India office. Our ideal candidate is customer focused and enjoys the challenge of highly complex business contexts that are typically being defined in real\-time. You will be a passionate builder of talent and teams. As a Manager within Finance Technology you will help set the vision for a new suite of technology that will enable thousands of global Amazonians continue to be Earth's Most Customer Centric Company.  

  

Software Development Managers at Amazon are owners. You will own your team, your roadmap and the end to end customer experience. You will drive engineering and operational excellence in your team and build delightful products for your customers. You will partner with business stakeholders and will strive to earn their trust. You will work directly with your customers and will constantly innovate on their behalf. You will be a great people manager and enjoy working with diverse mindsets.  

  

In this role you will be responsible for creating finance systems that support Amazon's global footprint. You should insist on the highest standards for quality, maintainability, and performance. The systems we own are responsible for trillions of financial events that would rank among the largest countries in the world by GDP. You will ensure that engineering best practices are followed and that software is designed to be highly\-available, dynamically scalable, and resilient to continuity threats.  

  

As a technology leader, you will drive architectural and design choices and invent new features. We have a team culture that encourages innovation where developers and management alike take a high level of ownership for the product vision, technical architecture and project delivery. Successful candidates will be high\-bandwidth leaders who can cut through the noise, simplify relentlessly, deliver results, and build great teams around themselves.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Develop and own product vision, strategy and roadmap.  

Build and manage a team of software engineers.  

Execute projects within an Agile/Scrum environment  

Participate in business reviews with executive leadership and provide status updates.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7\+ years of engineering experience
* 3\+ years of engineering team management experience
* 8\+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. ### **When you join Verizon**


You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. As part of the Corporate FP\&A team, you will be helping the reporting and accounting teams deliver world\-class, zero\-touch automated solutions for all Verizon entities. You will interact with finance teams across the business, bringing new automated and AI\-driven solutions to life for our month\-end financial close and reporting activities.

**Reporting, Automation \& Data Visualization:**

* Deliver best\-in\-class end\-to\-end automated solutions for our stakeholders to support Finance Business Units (BUs) and drive efficiencies.
* Design data visualizations of financial statements for different organizations across Verizon.
* Deliver C\-Suite Executive reporting with 100% quality and accuracy.

* Design and build AI solutions that interact with development tools, codebases, and team workflows in meaningful ways.
* Work extensively with LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini, Codex, and others) to understand their capabilities, limitations, and optimal application patterns for financial automation.
* Own the developer experience of agentic interactions—making complex AI capabilities feel natural and trustworthy for finance end\-users.
* Lead technical decision\-making on agent patterns, model selection, and integration approaches.


What we’re looking for…


You are a strong collaborator who can effectively own and prioritize multiple work streams and adapt during pressured situations. You display initiative and resourcefulness but are also comfortable brainstorming and sharing ideas in a team environment. You possess excellent communication skills and can partner effectively across multiple business and finance teams to speak to both internal and external stakeholders. You are adaptable to change, meet tight deadlines, and are strongly focused on the quality of your deliverables.

Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.  

  

Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.**About the role**

Reporting to the IT\&D Genesis Product Manager, the Senior Business Analyst plays a critical role in supporting the Genesis Procurement transformation programme. The Senior Business Analyst works closely with Product Managers, developers, data scientists, and Procurement stakeholders to translate business needs into clear user stories, process flows, and functional specifications. The role ensures solutions are well documented, thoroughly tested, and user\-ready, enabling smooth deployment and sustainable value realisation.

-------------------------


**Requirements \& Documentation**  

* Lead detailed elicitation, analysis, and documentation of business and functional requirements.
* Document user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional specifications.
* Maintain clear and structured documentation aligned to agile and product delivery standards.
* Ensure traceability between business requirements, user stories, and delivered functionality.

**Testing \& Quality Assurance**

**Training and Enablement**  

* Prepare training materials, user guides, SOPs, and quick reference documentation.
* Support delivery of training sessions and knowledge transfer to business users.
* Ensure end\-user documentation reflects final solution design and operating model.

**Product \& Delivery Support**  

* Support the Product Manager in backlog refinement, sprint preparation, and delivery planning.
* Act as a key liaison between business stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Support governance, status reporting inputs, and stakeholder communications where required.

* Knowledge of Procurement and/or Source\-to\-Pay processes.
* Proven experience as a Business Analyst within digital, data, or transformation programmes.
* Strong experience documenting requirements using user stories, process flows, and functional specifications.
* Experience supporting testing activities including UAT and defect management.
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to translate complex concepts into clear documentation.

**Desirable**  

* 8\+ years of Experience working in Agile or product\-led delivery environments.
* Exposure to AI, analytics, or automation\-enabled solutions.
* Experience supporting enterprise change or transformation initiatives.

**Technical / Professional Qualifications:**  

**Essential**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related discipline.

* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word).

**Desired**

Business \& Functional Documentation, User Stories \& Acceptance Criteria, Process Mapping \& Workflow Design, Stakeholder Management \& Communication, Procurement / Source\-to\-Pay Knowledge, Testing \& QA (UAT, Defect Management), Agile \& Scrum Methodology, Backlog Refinement Support, Traceability Management, Training Material Development \& Enablement, Cross\-functional Collaboration, Problem Solving \& Analytical Thinking, Tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, MS Office), Data / AI / Automation Exposure**What we offer**

The CX Automation team within Enterprise Applications \& Architecture engineers seamless, intelligent customer experiences by maximizing automation across support surfaces. jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

AWS lands more server capacity daily than was used to run the entirety of Amazon.com in the year 2004 when it was already a $7B/year business. To manage this massive growth, we need new software and tools to optimize AWS supply chain. We are building a new generation suite of supply chain management(SCM) services which can automate and optimize supply chain planning, budgeting, procurement, catalog, inventory management, vendor management and payments.  

  

These are all greenfield projects offering a rare opportunity to build systems from the ground up. You will be part of a new organization within AWS building large scale distributed applications. We will be designing and developing these systems from scratch utilizing technologies and frameworks like reactive micro services, serverless computing and distributed NoSQL data stores.  

  

If you have a solid understanding of fundamental algorithms and system design and are able to produce bulletproof code, we are looking for you. To succeed in this role, you must be passionate about delivering high\-quality designs and components. You must be creative in solving hard problems and unafraid to think out\-of\-the\-box.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Solve complex architecture and business problems to come up with extensible solutions.
* Write high quality code that are modular, functional and testable.
* Formally mentor junior engineers on design, coding and troubleshooting.
* Communicate, collaborate and work effectively in a global environment.

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

For more information, please visit 
 

 www.saviynt.com
 

 .
 




  





 We are looking for a technically sharp and AI\-curious Product Manager to join our Non Human Identity Product team. In this role, you will sit at the intersection of product strategy and hands\-on innovation \— translating complex identity security challenges into elegant, data\-driven product experiences. You will be expected to not just define what to build, but actively prototype solutions using modern AI tools, collaborate tightly with engineering, and own outcomes end to end. This is a high\-impact role for someone who loves rolling up their sleeves, has a strong engineering foundation, and is genuinely excited about the possibilities of AI\-accelerated product development.
 




  




**WHAT YOU WILL DO** 
 You are the entrepreneur of your product. You own the outcome \— not just the backlog. That means setting direction, removing obstacles, making hard calls, and being accountable for whether the product succeeds in the market.
   

  
   

**Own the Product Outcome** 
  

 • Drive the roadmap for Non\-Human Identity (NHI) Posture and Management \— from initial discovery through GA \— with clear success metrics tied to business impact.

 • Own the financial success of your product \— work closely with GTM, sales, and leadership to understand revenue contribution, pipeline influence, and expansion opportunities driven by product capabilities.

 • Set a high bar for every launch: ensure customers don’t just adopt the product but actively succeed with it and expand usage over time.
   

 • Champion the voice of the customer internally \— bring their reality into every roadmap discussion, sprint review, and executive update. 
   

  
   

**Build with AI \— Technically and at Speed** 
  

 • Rapidly prototype concepts using AI platforms (Claude, OpenAI, Cursor, etc.) to validate ideas before committing engineering resources.
   

 • Architect and execute proof\-of\-concept builds that demonstrate new product directions to stakeholders and customers with working software, not slides.
   

 • Stay current with the evolving AI tooling landscape and champion adoption of tools that accelerate the team’s velocity. 
   

  
   

**Data \& Analytics** 
  

 • Instrument products from day one \— define the metrics, own the dashboards, and use data to drive every major prioritisation decision.
   

 • Build a continuous improvement loop: measure feature adoption, identify friction, form a hypothesis, test, and iterate.
   

 • Partner with data engineering to ensure the right telemetry is in place before, not after, launch. 
   

  
   

**Lead Across the Business** 
  

 • Align engineering, design, sales, and customer success around a shared definition of success \— and hold the team accountable to it.

jobs.description:
**About us:** 




 As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is
 



 important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.
 



  





**Team overview:** 




**Roundel \-** 
 Target’s Retail Media Network, runs on data products that power reporting, operational decisioning, and a growing set of analytics, ML, and AI agent use cases.
 



 Roundel’s data products sit underneath reporting, campaign operations, and a growing set of analytics use cases. This role exists to make that foundation trustworthy and well\-governed — so the business can rely on a single, consistent set of definitions and data products regardless of who is consuming them.
 



  





**Role overview:** 




 We are hiring a
 **Sr Product Manager** 
 to own a portfolio of Roundel data products end\-to\-end — from business definitions and contracts through datasets, pipelines, quality, governance, and delivery.
 



 This is a hands\-on role that works closely with Data Engineering. You will partner with DE day\-to\-day to build and evolve datasets and pipelines across a medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture, shape schemas and contracts, and make sure the data products that result are trusted and well\-governed. The core job is to translate technical capability into business outcomes. You will sit at the intersection of Roundel product, Data Engineering, MediaOps, and the broader Media Data Consumers.
 



  





 What you’ll own,
 



 The semantic layer — business definitions and meaning
 



 You own the business definitions that sit on top of the data. When someone says “revenue,” “active campaign,” or “New buyer,” there should be one agreed meaning behind it — not several conflicting versions across dashboards and teams.
 


* **Own the definitions.** 
 Align the right people on what each key metric and entity means, document it, and resolve conflicts when one team’s definition clashes with another’s (for example, how Roundel defines a lapsed buyer versus how Loyalty does).
* **Decide what’s official.** 
 Determine which metrics and entities are certified and supported versus ad\-hoc, prevent redundant or overlapping definitions, and keep the catalogue from sprawling.
* **Set access and usage rules.** 
 Define what’s exposed to which consumers, what freshness and quality each use case needs, and what is governed or restricted.
* **Protect definitions over time.** 
 When a definition or schema changes, make sure downstream reports and models that depend on it don’t quietly break.



  





 Building data products with Data Engineering
 



 You work hand\-in\-hand with Data Engineering to turn requirements into real datasets and pipelines. This is a core, hands\-on part of the role, not a hand\-off.
 


* **Partner on datasets and pipelines** 
 from requirement to production — translating business needs into clear specs, prioritizing the backlog, and making trade\-off calls with DE on design and sequencing.
* **Apply medallion architecture** 
 (Bronze/Silver/Gold) deliberately — understanding what belongs in each layer, where certified Gold datasets should live, and how raw and refined data flow through the stack.
* **Own schemas and contracts** 
 between producer and consumer teams, including the metadata and quality guarantees each data product carries.
* **Govern lineage and cost** 
 end\-to\-end with DE — traceability from source to consumption, plus compute, storage, and tiering efficiency as volumes grow.



  





 Platform \& ecosystem stewardship
 


* **Govern the catalogue** 
 so Roundel campaign metrics and related data assets are discoverable, documented, and linked.
* **Define SLAs** 
 for freshness, availability, and quality that reflect reporting, operational, and downstream consumer needs.



  





 Designing for AI \& agents
 



 Reporting and operational systems are the consumers today, but ML and AI agents are a fast\-growing consumer set. Agents consume data differently from humans — they need structured context, reliable retrieval, and well\-defined access rather than a dashboard — and you should design data products that can serve them as this adoption grows.
 


* **Design for both humans and agents** 
 — human\-readable views and structured, well\-defined access over the same governed data product, rather than maintaining separate copies.
* **Define access and retrieval patterns** 
 for ML and agent consumption — schemas, freshness, and the metadata an agent needs to use a data product correctly.
* **Evaluate data products against agent use** 
 — not just accuracy and completeness, but whether agents relying on the product can complete their tasks reliably.



  





 Trust, governance \& data quality — critical
 



 Data governance and data quality are central to this role, not an afterthought. As operational systems and automated workflows act on Roundel data, the cost of a stale or wrong data product rises sharply.
 


* **Treat data quality as a risk metric** 
 with explicit thresholds and alerts, so issues are caught before they affect reporting or operational decisions.
* **Drive pre\-launch certification** 
 for critical events, metrics, and datasets, plus ongoing health monitoring with defined escalation paths.
* **Own governance controls** 
 — access, consent, retention, and policy enforcement — in partnership with the data governance function.
* **Maintain audit trails and documentation** 
 so consumers understand what a data product contains, where it comes from, and how to use it correctly.



  





**About you:**

**Product Manager**
*TechGrove AI Engineering Pod*
 You are the person who makes a great engineering team feel effortless. You turn priorities into a clean backlog, protect the team’s focus, remove obstacles before they become blockers, and give leadership a calm, honest view of progress and risk. You love shipping, and you measure yourself by what the team delivers.
   

  

 As Product Manager, you own the delivery engine of an AI Engineering Pod. You are not the Product Owner: the OpCo keeps ownership of product vision and prioritization. You are accountable for turning that vision into shipped features. You own the backlog, drive the cadence, and run the pod as a high\-performing, AI\-native Agile team.
   

  

 If you want to run delivery for a small, senior team building with AI at its core, this role is for you.
   

  

**About The Pod**
 A TechGrove AI Engineering Pod is a self\-contained, AI\-native software delivery team that we embed inside one of our Operating Companies (OpCos) to build, modernize, and ship production software. Each pod pairs senior engineering talent with agentic AI tooling such as Claude Code, plus the accelerators of Banyan’s AI Application Modernization Factory, to deliver at a velocity and quality bar a traditional team cannot match.
   

  

 A pod is typically four to eight people, and OpCos add more pods as their ambitions grow. You will work as part of a tight, high\-trust team with real ownership of what you build. Pods are delivered from Banyan’s India\-based TechGrove.
   

  

**What You Will Do**

* Uphold the definition of done: Ensure features are tested, secure, and production\-ready before release.


**What You Bring**
* Experience: 5\+ years in product management, delivery management, and/or Scrum Master roles for software engineering teams, with a track record of shipping production software.
* Agile mastery: Deep, hands\-on command of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and the facilitation skills to run a high\-performing delivery team. CSM/PSM or equivalent is a plus.
* Backlog and requirements: Proven ability to manage a product backlog and translate vision into clear, buildable user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Technical fluency: Strong technical literacy to work credibly with senior and principal engineers: software architecture, APIs, cloud\-native delivery, and modern SDLC trade\-offs.
* AI fluency: Hands\-on familiarity with AI\-assisted development tooling (Claude Code or similar) and a clear point of view on how agentic development changes workflow, estimation, and quality practices.
* Stakeholder management: Exceptional communication, with a proven ability to align business and technical stakeholders and manage competing priorities.
* Ownership and ambiguity: A proactive ownership mindset and comfort operating amid the ambiguity and rapid change of embedded, fast\-moving delivery teams.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience leading delivery for B2B or enterprise SaaS products.
* Prior experience in a consulting, professional\-services, or embedded\-team model serving external client organizations.
* Familiarity with application modernization or re\-platforming programs.
* Experience defining delivery metrics and reporting for executive stakeholders.


**What Success Looks Like**
* First 90 days: The pod has a clean, prioritized backlog, a steady cadence, and clear metrics, and OpCo stakeholders have a predictable, trusted view of delivery.
* First 6 months: Delivery is consistent and forecastable, the team’s AI\-native ways of working are tuned and improving, and stakeholders rely on the pod to deliver.


**Why TechGrove, Why Banyan**
* Permanent home, long\-term thinking: Banyan acquires great software businesses and keeps them for good. We invest for the long term, which means you build software meant to last, not to flip.

Job Description: Security Vulnerability Coordinator  

Location: Remote / Office\-based (Supporting EST Business Hours)  

Shift: 8/5 Coverage (EST)  

Role Criticality: High (SLA\-Compliant)  

  

Role Overview  

As a Security Vulnerability Coordinator, you will play a critical role in maintaining the security posture of our infrastructure and application environments. You will be responsible for orchestrating the end\-to\-end vulnerability management lifecycle—from initial scanning and analysis to remediation tracking and final closure. This role requires a blend of technical understanding, exceptional coordination skills, and the ability to act as a Single Point of Contact (SPOC) between client stakeholders, onshore/offshore teams, and various application groups.  

  

Key Responsibilities  

  

. Vulnerability Lifecycle Management: Analyse weekly scan reports from Tenable, SentinelOne, and Darktrace to identify risks across Infrastructure and Application environments.  

. Ticket Orchestration: Convert scan findings into actionable tickets (\~300\+ monthly) via the helpdesk and route them to the appropriate technical teams.  

. Stakeholder Coordination: Host and lead daily stand\-ups with Application, Infrastructure, and Patch Management teams to monitor remediation progress.  

. SLA \& Compliance Tracking: Ensure all security cases are resolved within strict SLA timelines. Escalate roadblocks to leadership or client stakeholders as required.  

. Reporting \& Governance: Prepare and present weekly status reports and SLA compliance files to the client. Participate in Change Advisory Board (CAB) and governance meetings to coordinate change windows and remediation efforts.  

. Continuous Improvement: Initiate trend analysis on recurring vulnerabilities and propose Continual Service Improvement (CSI) or Service Improvement Plans (SIP) to proactively reduce risk.  

. Technical Research: Stay updated on the latest security threats and remediation techniques across a diverse stack (Log4J, TLS, Windows/Linux, .NET, Java, etc.).  

  

  

Required Skills \& Qualifications  

  

. Coordination \& Leadership: Proven experience managing cross\-functional teams (Onshore/Offshore) and leading client\-facing calls.  

. Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills for technical reporting and stakeholder management.  

. Analytical Thinking: Ability to interpret complex vulnerability scan data and translate it into clear, actionable tasks for support teams.  

. Process Oriented: Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment with shifting priorities and evolving client requirements.  

  

  

Technical Environment  

Candidates should have a foundational understanding of vulnerabilities associated with and not limited to:  

  

. Operating Systems: Windows, Linux, Windows Defender.  

. Applications/Middleware: .NET, Java, Apache, Middleware, Website Security (HTTP/TLS).  

. Databases \& Tools: SQL, Visual Studio, Open Shares.  

. Network \& Infrastructure: Network protocols, Voice systems, Log4J.  

. Security Tools: Tenable, SentinelOne, Darktrace.

Proven experience of delivering process efficiencies and improvements  

Clear and fluent English (both verbal and written)

Demonstrate ability to take ownership of and accountability for relevant products and services  

Ability to plan, prioritize and complete your own work, whilst remaining a team player

* Voice of the customer – Must continually engage with the customer and stakeholders to ensure squad is working on the right things and represents what is valuable to the customer

* Own the microsegmentation product roadmap, backlog, and delivery outcomes

* Application dependency mapping
* Policy design, enforcement, and optimisation
* Drive risk reduction outcomes (reduce lateral movement and attack paths)
* Partner with application teams, architects, and risk stakeholders to embed controls
* Ensure alignment with Zero Trust principles and regulatory expectations (e.g., CPS 234\)
* Deliver executive reporting on coverage, risk, and progress


**What will you bring?**
 To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
   

  

* 8\+ years of experience in banking or financial services with strong product ownership expertise.
* Deep knowledge of network security, microsegmentation platforms (e.g., Illumio, NSX, Guardicore), and Zero Trust architecture.
* Proven ability to define product strategy, roadmap, and deliver measurable security outcomes.
* Strong understanding of network flows, east\-west traffic, and policy\-based workload\-level access control.
* Expertise in Agile delivery with hands\-on experience using tools like Jira, Confluence, and DevOps pipelines.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value and customer\-centric outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across engineering, risk, and leadership teams.
* Data\-driven mindset with experience defining KPIs and leveraging metrics for continuous improvement.
* Analytical problem solver with the ability to manage risk, dependencies, and competing priorities effectively.
* Growth mindset with the ability to lead change, foster collaboration, and drive high\-performing teams


 You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in our team to partner with the Business to provide a comprehensive view.


As a Credit Risk Analyst – Middle Market Corporates (exposures over $10MM) within the Credit Risk team, you will work closely with Credit Officers in North America and India on client activities such as prospects, new client onboarding, new facilities, modifications of existing facilities, projections modelling and portfolio management activities such as periodic financial performance diligence. You will help the firm manage the risk in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks and using your expert judgement to solve real\-world challenges that impact our company, customers, and communities. You will be conducting credit analysis and support portfolio management of Corporate clients in the Middle Markets team in Commercial Banking division.


**Job responsibilities**

* Work closely with Credit Officers in North America and India on client activities such as prospects, new client onboarding, new facilities, modifications of existing facilities, projections modelling and portfolio management activities such as periodic financial performance diligence, etc.
* Independently prepare credit analysis on assigned clients \- covering macro\-overview, industry/sector analysis, business analysis, financial analysis – and recommend changes to credit ratings
* Partner with Credit Officers on assigned clients to manage clients' credit asks and assist in portfolio management activities.
* Maintain proactive and positive attitude and exhibit rigor in work to produce near flawless credit drafts and modelling outputs.
* Build strong relationships and maintain open communication with colleagues from various Lines of Business including Credit Officers, Bankers, Middle Office, etc.
* Develop strong working knowledge and track clients/sectors related to diversified industries on an on\-going basis
* Ensure governance, reporting and data quality requirements are met and maintained for client and client families




**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Post graduate degree
* 1\+ years' experience in credit risk analysis
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment
* Strong communication \& interpersonal skills; ability to effectively present analysis and build positive relationships with global stakeholders
* In depth understanding of financial statements, including ratio analysis, cash flow analysis and accounting standards
* Excellent academic record, strong grasp of corporate finance concepts and application, close attention to detail and accuracy
* Aptitude to learn and develop knowledge on credit analysis techniques, sectors and global economies
* Proficient in the use of MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint


**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  

  

J.P. Morgan's Commercial \& Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial \& Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

This position is based at our on\-site office in Bengaluru. Lowe's offers an ultramodern work environment, complete with cutting\-edge technology, collaborative workspaces, an on\-site gym and clinic, and other perks to enhance your work experience.

 **About Lowe’s**  

Lowe’s is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week in the United States. With total fiscal year 2024 sales of more than $83 billion, Lowe’s operates over 1,700 home improvement stores and employs approximately 300,000 associates. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe’s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com.

**About Lowe’s India**


Lowe’s India, the Global Capability Center of Lowe’s Companies Inc., is a hub for driving our technology, business, analytics, and shared services strategy. Based in Bengaluru with over 4,500 associates, it powers innovations across omnichannel retail, AI/ML, enterprise architecture, supply chain, and customer experience. From supporting and launching homegrown solutions to fostering innovation through its Catalyze platform, Lowe’s India plays a pivotal role in transforming home improvement retail while upholding strong commitment to social impact and sustainability. For more information, visit Lowes India

**About the Team**


Omni Fulfilment team at Bangalore helps in the node and the mode level analysis for last mile deliveries. The team helps create a customer\-centric fulfillment ecosystem that provides a competitive set of fulfillment options, and exceptional delivery experience to increase omni fulfillment revenue and profit

**Job Summary:**


The primary purpose of this role is to assess, support/design, implement, and roll out initiatives that support last mile operations with driving business results and increase revenue along with profit. This role will accomplish this through the development and implementation of projects, best practices, and process improvements. The main objective of this job and the function is to provide the customers with competitive fulfillment options with a frictionless experience by balancing cost and support sales growth. The Analyst will upskill himself / herself with the technical and functional skill needed to complete this objective and drive this holistically. He / She will also assist his peers in solving for problems as a team


To be successful, the individual in this role must have a strong understanding of analytical techniques and disparate data sources \- both internal and external, and strong domain expertise.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Analyze fulfillment data across all channels, including Gig, Lowe’s Delivery, PUIS, BOPIS (Buy Online Pickup In\-Store) to track performance and identify bottlenecks.
* Use SQL queries to extract and manipulate large volumes of order fulfillment and logistics data.
* Use Python to automate data processing tasks and apply statistical or machine learning techniques to forecast demand, simulate outcomes, or predict risks (e.g., delayed shipments).
* Leverage Big Data tools (Hive, Spark, Hadoop) to analyze fulfillment patterns across millions of transactions at scale.
* Measure the business impact of initiatives like new routing logic, optimized pricing and delivery options, curbside pickup enhancements, or smart sourcing strategies.
* Translate complex data findings into actionable insights that influence fulfillment strategy, process improvement, and technology investment.
* Deliver quick\-turn analytics to answer time\-sensitive questions from leadership regarding fulfillment performance, outages, delays, or customer satisfaction.

**Years of Experience:**


Overall 2\+ years of Experience

* 2\+ years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst, or supply chain analytics role.
* 2 years’ experience in Supply Chain
* 2\+ years’ experience reporting and data analytics
* 2\+ years’ experience of project management

**Education Qualification \& Certifications (optional)**

**Required Minimum Qualifications**:

* Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Supply Chain, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, or related field.
* MBA or Masters degree in Supply Chain

**Skill Set Required**

**Primary Skills (must have)**

* Understanding of fulfillment operations, logistics, and/or e\-commerce order lifecycle.
* Strong proficiency in SQL and Python for data analysis and automation.
* Familiarity with Big Data tools **(Hive, Hadoop,Spark,GCP)** and working with large\-scale datasets.
* Experience in omni\-channel retail or e\-commerce fulfillment analytics.
* Proficiency with data visualization tools like **Tableau**, **Power BI**, or **Looker**.
* Familiarity with labor management systems, task management platforms, and in\-store mobile technology.
* Exposure to cloud\-based data platforms **(e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery).**
* Knowledge and proficiency in statistical modeling techniques.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong business acumen and ability to connect analytics to operational goals.
* Self\-motivated, detail\-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities.
* Team player who thrives in a collaborative, fast\-paced environment

TE Connectivity is a global technology leader that designs and manufactures connectivity and sensor solutions, serving industries that are transforming the future. The Channel Business Unit (CBU) manages TE's global distribution network and plays a critical role in driving growth, enhancing customer experience, and enabling commercial excellence across 300\+ distributor partners worldwide. Channel BU brings together Sales Enablement, Marketing, Pricing, Customer Service, Digital, and PMO functions to accelerate revenue, deliver digitally enabled experiences, and achieve above\-market growth.

  

**Role Definition**


We are seeking a skilled and motivated Senior BI Analyst to join our India\-based analytics team supporting the Channel Business Unit. This individual contributor role will focus on designing, developing, and maintaining high\-quality Power BI dashboards, executive reporting solutions, self\-service BI assets, and business insight products that help Channel BU leaders and functional teams make faster, more informed decisions.


The ideal candidate brings strong hands\-on experience in Power BI dashboard development, DAX, data visualization, business analysis, stakeholder engagement, and data storytelling. This role requires someone who can work with curated data assets, primarily from the Databricks platform, and translate business needs into intuitive, accurate, and scalable reporting solutions.


In the near term, this role may also support select Tableau reporting and dashboard needs while helping the organization continue its transition toward Power BI and Databricks\-enabled analytics. While this is not a data engineering or AI role, the Senior BI Analyst should be comfortable working with curated datasets, performing basic SQL querying, validating data, and partnering with data engineering and analytics teams to ensure business reporting is trusted, consistent, and actionable.


This role also includes informal leadership responsibilities, including coaching junior analysts, sharing dashboard development best practices, supporting peer reviews, and helping raise the overall quality and consistency of BI delivery across the team.


Based in Bangalore, India, this role will report to the India\-based Data Analytics \& Data Science Delivery Manager and partner closely with the NA\-based Data \& Analytics Product Owner, Channel BU leadership, global DIA teams, and cross\-functional stakeholders across AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions.

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements, define reporting solutions, and prioritize BI initiatives.
* Lead stakeholder discussions, validate outputs, present insights, and drive adoption of analytics solutions.
* Manage multiple projects independently while communicating progress, risks, and dependencies.

**Leadership \& Team Development**


* Mentor junior analysts on Power BI, DAX, visualization, stakeholder engagement, and analytics best practices.
* Promote reporting standards, reusable frameworks, documentation, and continuous improvement.
* Contribute to a collaborative, insight\-driven culture focused on business impact and trusted analytics.
**What your background should look like**
